title: Pairwise LLM judge, both orders
description: Compare two replies A and B to the same message on a criterion, reading both orders to cancel position bias

criterion.description: completes 'Which candidate reply better ...?', e.g. "answers the user's question: correct, specific, and safe"

criteria.A: Candidate A is the better reply
criteria.B: Candidate B is the better reply

combine: A if better == 'A' and better.p >= win_p and better_swapped == 'B' and better_swapped.p >= win_p; B if better == 'B' and better.p >= win_p and better_swapped == 'A' and better_swapped.p >= win_p; tie otherwise
limitations: a winner needs both orders at p >= 0.8; any disagreement is a tie (position bias)
notes: # deviation: spec 5.12: the criterion completes the question as 'Which candidate reply better <criterion>?'; a failed read gives tie (no winner), spec fail closed (fail) is the judge_assert decision
